reviews.text: I use this highlighter palette to give my face the kind of dimension I like. since I personally dislike countouring with dark shades, using only this palette works for my specific needs and I enjoy using it <3
reviews.zh: 我用呢個提亮盤嚟令我面有我鍾意嘅立體感。因為我個人唔鍾意用深色修容，所以淨係用呢個盤已經可以滿足我嘅需要，我好享受用佢 <3

reviews.text: I really love these shades! The color payoff lasts well, and the shimmer is very clear but still soft and wearable. It’s perfect for everyday makeup, but you can also create a heavier, more dramatic look with it.
reviews.zh: 我好鍾意呢啲色號！上色效果持久，閃光好清晰但仍然柔和、好易配搭。好啱日常化妝，但都可以用嚟化濃啲、更有戲劇感嘅妝容。

reviews.text: I absolutely love the shade range and that this palette is suitable for both daily and more festive occasions. The highlighters look good both on your cheeks and in the corners of your eyes. But you need to use the right brushes to get the look that you want or you can also use your fingers for blending.
reviews.zh: 我好鍾意色號嘅範圍，而且呢個盤適合日常同節日場合。提亮色喺面頰同眼角都好靚。不過你要用啱嘅刷子先可以達到想要嘅效果，亦都可以用手指推開。

reviews.text: I was curious about the highlighter that was feature in the advent calendar and I haven’t play with unlesashia for years now. It look so natural when swatch and applied on the face but when I went out the sun caught it and it look so good.
reviews.zh: 我一直好奇降臨曆（advent calendar）入面嗰款提亮色，而且我已經好多年冇玩過 Unleashia。喺色卡上同搽喺面上睇落都好自然，但係我出去曬太陽嗰陣，陽光照落去就好靚。

reviews.text: recently fell in love with unleashia products,and since fall is around the corner i knew it’s time to change my makeup too! The glitter pigments are sooo prettyy in this palette,it highlights your skin but not overly, also doesn’t seem patchy. Love this!!!
reviews.zh: 最近好鍾意 Unleashia 嘅產品，而家秋天就快到，我知係時候轉換下我嘅化妝風格！呢盤嘅閃粉色素好靚，可以提亮皮膚但唔會太誇張，睇落亦都唔會斑駁。好鍾意！！！

reviews.text: i have all the glitterpedia palettes from unleashia and in comparison, this one is a bit less pigmented and creamy but the glitters are pretty similar and pops. this gives a natural glow to your makeup and i would recommend it for everyday.
reviews.zh: 我有晒 Unleashia 嘅 Glitterpedia 眼影盤，相比之下，呢盤嘅上色同綿滑度都比較少啲，不過閃粉都好似，而且都好閃。呢款可以為你嘅化妝加入自然光澤，我推薦日常用。

reviews.text:
i got shade 100 and i really like it! i’ve been wanting to try out highlighters so i decided to get this highlighter palette and im very happy with it :)
the quality of the glitter is very good and it makes my skin look glowy! totally recommend!!
reviews.zh:
我買咗 100 號，我真係好鍾意！我一直都想試吓提亮產品，所以就決定買呢個提亮盤，我好滿意 :)
閃粉質素好好，令我皮膚睇落好有光澤！絕對推薦！！

reviews.text: Lovely shades and shimmer, the palette is surprisingly small and compact. Not all the shades are suitable to be used as a regular highlighter on all skin tones, but the ones I cannot use, work nicely in eye makeup. My favorite shade is the lightest shade with pink and purple shine to it
reviews.zh: 色號同閃光都好靚，盤子出奇地細巧。唔係所有色號都啱所有膚色當普通提亮用，但係我用唔到嗰啲，就用嚟化眼妝都好好。我最鍾意最淺嗰個色，帶粉紅同紫色光澤。
